scope: Finite regression of a proved one-sided-complete threshold-search invariant, not an algorithm finder or a scheduling certificate.
proof: With integer optimum q>0 maintain low<q and an accepted high. Rejecting mid implies mid<q by completeness on every threshold at least q; accepting only needs a verified output of cost <=alpha*mid. At adjacent endpoints high=low+1<=q. Thus the final verified output has cost <=alpha*q, without monotonicity below q. Handle q=0 separately.
